posts.text: A new RAND study finds that stricter school cell phone policies are associated with less student phone use in class, but even the most restrictive policies don't completely stop students from checking their phones. bit.ly/3PC9owG

New study on school cell phone policies ⬇️

Even in schools that ban phone use entirely, half of students said they still check their phones in class at least once a day. 

Roughly one-sixth said they do so more than five times per day. bit.ly/42Oz501
